description: Source code for the HttpConnection class and its nested classes ReadIOBuffer and QueuedWriteIOBuffer, implementing buffer management and socket handling within the net namespace.

classes.name: HttpConnection
classes.description: Manages HTTP connection including read/write buffers and WebSocket association.

methods.name: SetWebSocket
methods.description: Associates a WebSocket with the HTTP connection.

classes.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer
classes.description: Manages read buffer for HTTP data, including capacity adjustments and data consumption.

classes.name: HttpConnection::QueuedWriteIOBuffer
classes.description: Manages queued write buffer for HTTP data, supporting appending and consuming data.

methods.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer::IncreaseCapacity
methods.description: Increases buffer capacity if below maximum.

methods.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer::StartOfBuffer
methods.description: Returns pointer to start of buffer.

methods.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer::GetSize
methods.description: Returns current data size in buffer.

methods.name: HttpConnection::ReadIOBuffer::DidConsume
methods.description: Handles data consumption and buffer resizing.

methods.name: HttpConnection::QueuedWriteIOBuffer::DidConsume
methods.description: Updates buffer after data is written.

methods.name: HttpConnection::QueuedWriteIOBuffer::GetSizeToWrite
methods.description: Returns size of data pending to write.
